request.setup_evidence: User-confirmed unloaded bench, September 14; internal servo encoder only; attached inertia/load torque and sensor sample age unmeasured. Desired ramp speed 3.515625 degrees/s, capped at 7.5 percent PWM. This is not maximum-speed or loaded validation. Tolerance 0.02 rad/s and dwell 0.25 s preregistered for timing commissioning; not a relaxed tracking/model gate.

conditions.timing_evidence: Captured host request/receipt windows, not exact device-clock application or internal sample time. Current is raw register counts; amps, power and battery validation are unavailable.

rise_10_to_90.unresolved: Crossing is not bracketed by resolved speed estimates

command_to_settled_speed.unresolved: Initial speed or sustained final plateau is unresolved; check tolerance, quantization, dwell and record length

zero_to_settled_opposite_speed.unresolved: Both a resolved zero crossing and opposite-speed plateau are required

measured.interpretation: Secant speed from encoder positions; acceleration compares separated secants. Both measured and simulated encoders use the same estimator and timing windows. Bounds cover declared encoder quantization and transaction/sample-age windows, not encoder calibration error or unobserved motion. Crossings and settling describe the sampled estimates; they are not guaranteed instantaneous mechanical times or maximum motor capability. No time shift or automatic model promotion. Onset is departure from the initial-speed tolerance band. Travel is the largest sampled forward excursion from the last pre-command encoder sample through the zero-crossing bracket; sub-sample extrema and exact command-time angle are unknown. Unknown sample age adds unbounded uncertainty when sample_age_bounded=false.
